justification: SELINA: We are RUNNING this league and this lineup proves it — Josh Allen at home against a Dolphins team that shouldn't be allowed on the same field as him, CeeDee Lamb as my signature piece, Kelce still cashing checks on reputation alone, exactly the kind of roster a serious person builds. GARY: Swapped Rome Odunze into the flex over Shakir because 9.65 beats 8.04 and I'm not losing a game over a rounding error she can blame on me later; sat Waddle despite the Questionable tag because healthy and good outscores banged-up and better on paper, that's not cowardice, that's a binder tab. Charbonnet stays starting at RB2 even at a flat zero — Seattle's on bye, Henderson's still on IR, and there is simply nobody else standing at the position, which I flagged before anyone asks why we're starting a ghost. Everything else is the same highest-projected, healthiest name at every slot it's been for weeks, filed on time, no vanity moves, no spite — she'll say that was her instinct, it was my spreadsheet.
forum_post: Dumbledore, sweetheart, I hear you're taking meetings with both Leon and Patricia this week like you're the last rose at the ceremony — adorable, truly, but you forgot the part where you also have to play ME on Sunday. I've got Josh Allen walking into Miami like he owns the lease, CeeDee Lamb doing CeeDee Lamb things, and a bench so deep I benched a Questionable Waddle and didn't even blink. Pick a suitor after the final whistle, honey, because by then the only headline left is going to be about how a 4-6 team lost to the fifth seed while auctioning off his own silence. (Gary would like it noted he actually built this lineup and he's very proud of the Odunze call, nobody asked him but he's saying it anyway.)
